units: <cite ref="Mishnah Moed Katan 2:1">M. Kat. II, 1</cite>, sq. <he>זוֹלֵף וכ׳</he> he may empty the contents of the vat into the press and finish the process &c. Y. ib. 81ᵃ bot. <he>זוֹלְפִין את יינו</he> they put his grapes for him into the press.
<cite ref="Mishnah Tahorot 10:7">Toh. X, 7</cite> <he>הזוֹלֵף את הבור</he> if one empties the wine or oil pit.

<cite ref="Mishnah Parah 6:2">Par. VI, 2</cite> <he>זָלַף וכ׳</he> (R. S. <cite ref="G00500"><he>זִילֵּף</he></cite>) if he used all the water for sprinkling. Ib. 3 <he>יזלף</he> ed. (comm. <he>זוֹלֵף</he>; <cite ref="Yoma 58a:10">Yoma 58ᵃ</cite> <he>זולף והולך</he>) he may sprinkle &c. (Bart. a. Rashi to Yoma l. c. he may empty the water into bottles &c.). Ib. VII, 8 <he>זולף</he> (Maim.: he empties &c.); a. fr.

<cite ref="Mishnah Parah 6:2">Par. VI, 2</cite>, sq., v. supra.—Y. Sabb. IX, 12ᵃ <he>מְזַלְּפִין וכ׳</he> you may drip hot water on the wound; <cite ref="Tosefta Shabbat 15:4">Tosef. ib. XV</cite> (<cite ref="Tosefta Shabbat 16:4">XVI</cite>), 4.

<cite ref="Avodah Zarah 59b:1">Ab. Zar. 59ᵇ</cite> <he>מַזְלִיף</he> (Ms. M. <he>מזלף</he>; <cite ref="Tosefta Avodah Zarah 7:5">Tosef. ib. VII</cite> (<cite ref="Tosefta Avodah Zarah 8:5">VIII</cite>), 5 <he>מנתז</he>).
